patterns: Genuine PYQs are few and simple: Nehru initiated non-alignment; the chronology Tashkent, Indo-Soviet Treaty, Simla, Farakka; Bangladesh born December 1971 (APPSC).
Most APPSC items filed here are really awards, sports or schemes current affairs, so APPSC rarely asks phase theory.
Likely APPSC angles are PM-to-initiative matches and dated events (9 Aug 1971, 1972 Simla, 1974/1998 Pokhran, 2008 NSG waiver).
The app leans on Jaishankar's six-phase labels and abstract terms (multi-alignment, strategic autonomy) with A-R items. That is more conceptual than the PYQs.
